blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Targeted academic interventions, such as the Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning (ARAL) Program, need to be sustained, especially now that Filipino students have shown significant performance gains in the latest Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA). Education Secretary Sonny Angara emphasized that point in a statement issued on Tuesday. As the statement points out, the Philippines’ PISA 2025 performance is its strongest showing in reading, mathematics, and science since it joined the global assessment in 2018. The country emerged as the fastest-improving education system in reading over a 10-year trend, gaining 38 points overall. Compared with 2022 levels, […]...
